items.title: Roche (SWX:ROP) Starts Breast Cancer Trial With Evexta Bio Using Two Drug Candidates
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) has entered a clinical collaboration with Evexta Bio to test a combination of rupitasertib and giredestrant. The partnership focuses on a Phase 1b trial in ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated metastatic breast cancer. The agreement centers on a breast cancer segment with significant unmet medical need.
